newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul airport closed to air traffic due to fog.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul airport closed to air traffic due to fog.

text.p: Istanbul's Ataturk Airport had been closed to air traffic since early morning due to heavy fog over the city, airport officials said on Wednesday.
"The airport is closed to traffic since six a.m. (0400 GMT). Most of the planes to Istanbul are landing in Ankara." said one official.
"The meteorological office informed us that the visibility will become better by 11 a.m. (0900 GMT) as the fog is gradually expected to disappear by then," she said.
